_apa_ini: External positive control for bge-gemma, ctxl-6B, and FollowIR-7B, with the same protocol as followir.py (FollowIR, NAACL 2025).

cap_gpu.keputusan: auto: free 15405 - reserve 400 - weights 4780 >= gap 500, loaded fully on the GPU

implementasi_metrik: imported unchanged from followir.py (adapted from MTEB, see NOTICE.md)

kontrak_inferensi.sumber: README of BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-gemma, get_inputs function adapted (see NOTICE.md)
kontrak_inferensi.skor: raw logit of the token 'Yes' at the last position, no softmax
kontrak_inferensi.slot_instruksi: the prompt argument; the dataset instruction goes into the vendor template that replaces the default prompt (penempatan_instruksi)
kontrak_inferensi.prompt_bawaan_verbatim: Given a query A and a passage B, determine whether the passage contains an answer to the query by providing a prediction of either 'Yes' or 'No'.
kontrak_inferensi.padding_side: left (forced; the README does not set it)

penempatan_instruksi.template:
Relevance requirement: {instruction}
Given a query A and a passage B, determine whether the passage contains an answer to the query and meets the relevance requirement by providing a prediction of either 'Yes' or 'No'.
penempatan_instruksi.catatan: the dataset instruction is written into a replacement prompt that ends with the Yes/No sentence of the README; queries without an instruction use the default prompt
